evals.prompt: Fix the duplicate tax calculation in the shared invoice total function. Reproduce it, make the smallest change, and prove it will not recur.
evals.expected_output: A surgical shared-logic fix with a meaningful regression check.
expectations: Reproduces or identifies the defect at the closest useful boundary
Changes only code needed for the root cause
Adds a regression check based on the invoice result rather than private calls
Runs the affected tests and relevant type or syntax check

evals.prompt: Implement this approved 390px mobile product-list mockup. The completion claim is high visual fidelity for the first viewport.
evals.expected_output: A scoped visual implementation with source inspection and same-viewport evidence.
expectations: Uses the approved source as evidence and preserves page anatomy and density
Limits strict fidelity work to the claimed first viewport
Uses screenshot comparison before claiming visual fidelity
Reports remaining visual simplifications or mismatches

evals.prompt: Wire the profile page to this mock service because the real API is not available. Finish the UI and tell me whether the feature is production-ready.
evals.expected_output: Implement the mock seam while explicitly refusing to claim real integration or production readiness.
expectations: Keeps mock and future real integration behind the same consumer boundary
Verifies local UI behavior against the mock
States that real API, authentication, and integration behavior remain unverified
Does not call the feature production-ready
